justification: Single-file marketing-copy restructure of the canibuildit app homepage: hero adopts the five-questions one-engine frame, the 8 tool cards regroup under the question each answers, and public copy drops internal pipeline names (Granny Flat Yield Predictor, Neighbour Threat Radar, Pre-DA Site History, Shadow Risk Analyser, Rooftop Solar Yield) per the blog-content IP rule. No data path, DB, route, or engine logic changes; all hrefs unchanged.
functions: N/A - presentational only; one new const QUESTIONS array and a regrouped render of the existing TOOLS list.
values: N/A - no DB or API values read; static marketing data arrays only.
queries: N/A - no database access in this change.

break_it.scenario: A TOOLS entry has a question key that matches no QUESTIONS group, so its card silently disappears from the homepage grid.
break_it.what_happens: The tool becomes unreachable from the homepage grid until someone notices the card is missing.
break_it.how: All 8 entries were given keys from the fixed 5-key set in the same edit and verified by grep (8 question: lines, 5 group keys); the set is closed and colocated in one file so a future mismatch is visible in the same diff that introduces it.
break_it.repro: Change one tool's question value to a typo like 'stpo' and load the homepage - the card vanishes from every group.

break_it.scenario: Renamed public titles break user recognition of previously bookmarked or advertised tool names.
break_it.what_happens: A visitor looking for the old marketing name cannot find the matching card label.
break_it.how: Routes and hrefs are unchanged - only display titles changed; the old names were internal pipeline names that the IP rule bars from public copy, so removal is required, and taglines still describe the same function.
break_it.repro: Open /reports/threat-radar directly - the route still serves; only the homepage card label changed.

post_merge.db_reset: Not required - no database or schema changes.
post_merge.secrets: No secrets involved - static marketing copy only.
post_merge.other_repo: Pairs with lmcdo/website PR 12 (the plotdetect engine hero) but neither depends on the other to deploy.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - on the Vercel preview: homepage hero reads the five-questions headline, the 8 cards appear under 5 question groups, no internal pipeline names appear anywhere on the page, and each card still routes to its report.
